rationale: Create one North American operating platform for the U.S. and Canadian EDF power solutions businesses. EDF remains the active legal owner. The definitive KKR acquisition is recorded only as signed pending incoming through KKR Global Infrastructure Investors V and KKR Lafayette Buyer, Inc. until legal closing evidence is available; Mexico and parallel EDF businesses remain outside the record.

afterImage.name: EDF Power Solutions North America
afterImage.subsector: Utility-scale renewable generation, energy storage, and power infrastructure
afterImage.description: EDF Power Solutions North America develops, owns, and operates utility-scale wind, solar, and battery-storage infrastructure across the United States and Canada and also provides construction, operations, maintenance, and asset-management services. Public transaction materials report 5.6 GW of net installed capacity at March 31, 2026 and a 19.2 GW development pipeline. EDF remains the current legal owner. KKR signed a definitive agreement on June 30, 2026 to acquire the U.S. and Canadian operations through KKR Global Infrastructure Investors V, but no legal closing was identified through September 1, 2026, so KKR is recorded only as pending incoming.
